name: tbi-lab
description: TBI Lab. Production code lives in app/ and packages/; experiments/ is frozen Sprint 0/1 evidence.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.specs.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain && tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine && tsc --noEmit -p app && tsc --noEmit -p app/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check app packages scripts eslint.config.js playwright.app.config.ts vitest.config.ts && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write app packages scripts eslint.config.js playwright.app.config.ts vitest.config.ts
